Our Story: Why build a new browser?

Today, nearly all enterprise work is done on a browser. Yet the browser was never designed for the enterprise. This forces organizations to do expensive, complex, and unnatural things to the work environment, just to make it work for them.

‍
So we asked ourselves - what if the browser was designed for the enterprise? And like that, The Enterprise Browser was born. Today, Island is used by the largest, most impactful enterprises worldwide to make work smooth, simple, and fundamentally secure.

‍

It may be one small change, but sometimes changing one thing changes everything.

Why build a new enterprise workspace?

Island is shaping the future of work – creating an enterprise workspace for both knowledge workers and agents – where access, security, and AI-powered productivity are built in. Our enterprise agentic control plane boosts productivity across devices, browsers, applications, networks, and data while protecting sensitive information, simplifying access, and helping enterprises scale AI safely.

This time, it’s different.

We’ve researched every corner of the modern enterprise. Built industry-defining tech like antivirus software and browser isolation. Delivered products like DLP and proxies to millions worldwide. But what we’re building now—it’s not another solution. It’s the foundation for the future of work. The challenges, the complexity, the scale—this is bigger than everything we’ve ever done. Combined.

Build the future of work with us.

We’re a team of hungry, high-character professionals from all backgrounds who came together to reinvent work for the modern enterprise. And we’re always looking for world-class human beings (not resumes) to join the movement.
